contract.gap: Conformance rates for governed LLM agents can condition on a state authored by the agent in the same generation being judged; the denominator can therefore be changed by the enforcement loop itself.
contract.task: Evaluate whether a conformance statistic remains interpretable when its rule condition includes an agent-reported state, using paired validator-on/off simulations and bounded decomposition checks.

questions.text: Does enforcement change the distribution of the agent-reported rule condition as well as the rate computed on it?
In the anchor irrigation configuration, is the rule-condition shift explained mainly by different simulator-recorded world states rather than by report revision within a fixed world?
What reporting practice remains defensible when the conditional statistic and a design-fixed denominator answer different questions?

contract.contribution: A bounded construct-validity warning for runtime governance metrics, an evidence-backed world-state decomposition on the anchor cell, and a low-cost reporting prescription: publish rule-condition prevalence and an independent world record beside the conditional rate.
nonclaims: not a claim about every governance stack or every LLM
not evidence that agents deceive or game the rule
not a claim that the unconditional rate is the corrected or true effect
not empirical validation of real-world behavior

semantic_locks.meaning: Delta = no-validator minus with-validators; positive means validators lowered the quantity.
The seed is the inferential unit; cell values are means of per-seed rates.
Published results use the LAST-PROPOSED reading; executed-action values are a separately labelled sensitivity reading.
The recorded-world composition decomposition is demonstrated on the anchor irrigation cell; broader patterns are reported as supporting or descriptive evidence only.
Flood is a portability demonstration with no action-to-environment feedback, not a control for enforcement pressure.

terminology.first_use: define as high or very high water-scarcity report

terminology.preferred: increase rate among decisions where the agent said scarcity was high
increase rate out of every decision
reweighting by the simulator-recorded world state

terminology.first_use: use technical term only after plain explanation

discouraged_phrases: de-conditioning without an explicit denominator definition
selection on acceptance is not what produces the effect

facts.statement: The current corpus is complete and balanced: 5 irrigation cells with 3 or 5 paired seeds and 9 flood cells with 5 paired runs.
The evidence regeneration pipeline completes 15/15 scripts with exit code 0 on 2026-08-04.
In gemma3:4b irrigation, HIGH prevalence Delta is +45.73 pp and conditional increase-rate Delta is +23.02 pp.
On the anchor cell, the recorded-world reweighted residual is -2.53 pp at 100% coverage and +0.21 pp at the finest reported stratification with 43.4% coverage.

Under the design-fixed denominator, gemma3:12b changes from +11.44 pp conditional to +0.16 pp unconditional, while ministral3:8b changes from +2.80 pp conditional to -22.17 pp unconditional under LAST-PROPOSED.
The current PDF passes all eight submission gates: evidence, figures, build, venue, pages, fonts, anonymity, and citations; it embeds 8 Type 1 and 3 TrueType fonts and no Type 3 fonts.

alignment.method: Compare validator-on and no-validator arms within each model/testbed cell; compute per-seed HIGH prevalence and conditional rates; decompose rejection causes.
alignment.result: The agent-reported HIGH prevalence shifts in the same runs that produce the conformance contrast; rejection layers are separated before later claims are narrowed to rules that read the reported condition.
alignment.interpretation: A conditional conformance number can change because its own denominator changes.
alignment.limitation: The corpus does not establish a causal dose-response and rule regime is confounded with testbed across the two families.
alignment.contribution: Makes rule-condition prevalence a required companion statistic for this class of evaluation.

alignment.method: Stratify on simulator-recorded world state and reweight both arms to common distributions on the anchor cell; corroborate with year-1 exogeneity, reservoir trajectories, and the never-blocked stratum.
alignment.result: The raw +45.73 pp anchor shift leaves a -2.53 pp residual at the coarse 100%-coverage rung and +0.21 pp at the finest reported rung; the arms diverge in reservoir state after year 1.
alignment.interpretation: Within the anchor simulation, the observed shift is consistent with composition of simulator-recorded world states; this is descriptive reweighting, not a causal adjustment claim.
alignment.limitation: The world is downstream of enforcement, the first attempt is not logged, fine strata lose coverage, and the decomposition is scoped to the anchor cell.
alignment.contribution: Separates independence from the generation from independence from treatment, preventing an over-broad identification claim.

alignment.method: Recompute the effect over the design-fixed denominator and test a world-state condition on the anchor cell.
alignment.result: The fixed-denominator statistic is a different estimand; it is near zero on gemma3:12b and reverses sign on ministral3:8b, while moving the norm to world state also produces a shifted condition.
alignment.interpretation: Report rule-condition prevalence, an independent world record, and a design-fixed rate beside the conditional rate rather than calling any one a corrected truth.
alignment.limitation: No first-attempt logging or untreated-trajectory enforcement arm is available.
alignment.contribution: Provides a low-cost reporting and audit prescription for runtime governance evaluations.

issues.description: The gate was stricter than the official template: embedded TrueType is permitted, while Type 3 remains forbidden. The default gate now accepts embedded TrueType and the final PDF has no Type 3 fonts.
The abstract now distinguishes the simulator's independent world record from the deployment limitation before stating the evidence and reporting prescription.
The never-retried comparison is now described as supporting evidence rather than a causal test; the different filtering of the two arms is stated explicitly.
The Figure 2 caption now distinguishes the all-blocks increase/decrease split from panel c's within-rule-type denominators; the two displayed bases are no longer presented as a common partition.
Figure 4 and its caption now state that the denominator changes the contrast in every cell, including the ministral3:8b sign reversal, instead of claiming that the magnitude shrinks everywhere.

Figure 1 uses a reviewed image-generated flat-icon raster schematic for concept communication; it is not a data-bearing plot or an editable vector. The one-answer record, validator gate, and measurement lens are visually separated, the reported-state field is explicitly labelled in the answer record and denominator, the validator is scoped as reading the reported condition, the numerator names selected records, terminal arrowheads are visible inside their targets, the retry path returns to the answer record, the caption separates agent-reported from world-recorded rules, and standalone plus manuscript print-size inspection passed.
